Personally I feel like adding flying in now is too late. While Aviana's Feather has been extremely helpful all through this expansion, I also think that it comes with a downside. We already know that almost the entirety of Draenor is "flyable", since we've had the feather and some 1 minute flying mounts from the large garrison plot engineering shack. This means that for a lot of people (myself included), exploring has been limited to a cooldown on either the feather or the other temporary mounts we've been given. I am completely fine with the MoP and BC way of giving players flying, by paying a fee after reaching max level. I also think that WotLK did it best, by making certain zones require flying to level up the last few levels. This will let you explore some of the zones you've already passed, giving a player that wants it, the chance to explore past zones (and new ones ofc), and take a break from leveling. I think the Draenor way would have been acceptable if it was available from patch 6.0, or maybe even 6.1. Making it impossible to fly for the majority of an expansion is however something I hope blizzard will not do again. I'd rather go back to Cataclysm where flying was available from lvl 80 through 85 than having to wait until the last patch to be able to fly.

And this is not even touching on alts. With Legion, alts is going to be even more of a hassle than it is today, by having no catch up mechanic (thinking about the Relic weapon here). So I really hope flying mounts will be available at max level in Legion, but I'm afraid it's gonna be the WoD way (which again, would be okay if it was available from 6.0 or maayybe 6.1).
